issues.description: Field mismatch: The Person.birthday field is declared as type String in the solution implementation, but the template and tests expect java.time.LocalDate. Specifically, solution_repository/src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java declares 'private String birthday;' while its getter and setter (public LocalDate getBirthday(), public void setBirthday(LocalDate)) and the test code invoke setBirthday(LocalDate). This inconsistency causes compilation errors and prevents students from running or testing the project as provided.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the Person.birthday field type consistent with the getters, setters, and tests. Change the declaration in src/main/java/de/tum/in/ase/eist/model/Person.java to 'private java.time.LocalDate birthday;' (and import java.time.LocalDate if needed). This keeps the getter and setter signatures and test usages valid and resolves the compilation error while preserving the exercise intent.
